normalization: Linear clamp to each registry metric min/max, oriented so higher normalized values are better. Unknown or inferred units are not admitted.
familyCap: Average compatible suite rows within each benchmark family, then average families equally within each capability domain.
cohortRule: Require the same exact suite version, task, split, metric, direction and tested configuration for every cohort model. A configured domain weight is never redistributed per model; missing a positively weighted domain makes the overall score unavailable.
eligibility: no unmerged refs/pr/* model repository revision

currentCaptureAudit.reason: No current observation meets the documented-unit and publisher/authority confirmation admission rules.

priceScenario: USD task cost is available only when every positively used token class has a source rate; prompt-token threshold overrides supersede base prompt/completion/cache rates. No rate is inferred from a missing field.
